label: MD resident
mission: Get through residency without losing the reason I came — and come out a physician who understands how the system actually runs.
sub: Daniel Ferreira, MD · PGY-2, internal medicine · Step 3 behind him, boards ahead · in-training exam on 22 October.
seasonBody: Intern year was survival and chief year is coming. This is the one where you either build the habits or inherit whatever the schedule gives you.
seasonMeta: Month 3 of 12 · Step 3 cleared in June · ITE 22 October · boards 2028

actions.title: Protect the post-call sleep block you keep trading
actions.why: Four of the last six post-call days went to errands instead of sleep. Every metric on this screen that dipped, dipped in the week that followed one of them.
actions.cost: 2 minutes to block · nothing else moves

actions.title: Recertify PSLF employment before the window closes
actions.why: A missed certification year is a permanently missed year of qualifying payments. It is a form, it takes twelve minutes, and it is worth more than anything else on this list.
actions.cost: 12 minutes · waits at a human gate

actions.title: Forty questions before the ITE, from your own misses
actions.why: The exam is on 22 October and your weakest two areas have not moved since July. Scholar has the set built from what you actually got wrong.
actions.cost: 45 minutes · split it if you need to

health.signal: Four of six post-call days spent awake on errands.
health.detail: This is the lowest health share on any role in this prototype, and it is not a character flaw — it is a schedule. The one lever you hold is the post-call block, and it is currently unheld.

family.signal: Two of the last six planned calls home happened.
family.detail: It has slipped every month since July. Noticed, not judged — but you asked to be told, and this is the telling.

career.signal: Duty hours attested weekly. Milestone review clean at six months.
career.detail: The largest share on the screen, which for PGY-2 is simply accurate. Your training license, DEA, and duty-hour record are held separately, above — they are not a share of your week.

learning.signal: ITE prep 480 questions in. Two weak areas unmoved since July.
learning.detail: Volume is excellent; targeting is not. Unmoved weak areas after 480 questions means the sets are too broad — Scholar can narrow them to your misses.

finance.signal: PSLF employment certification due before 30 September.
finance.detail: A missed year of qualifying payments cannot be recovered later. Twelve minutes now against a permanent cost — the clearest cost-benefit on this screen.

creative.signal: Case report paused until after the ITE. Logged 4 August.
creative.detail: A chosen pause with a date, not a dropped ball. It will not be surfaced as a signal until 25 October.

service.signal: Two medical-student teaching sessions a month, held.
service.detail: The first thing most residents drop, and you have not. It is also the best boards prep available to you, which makes it a two-for-one.

business.signal: Nothing here, on purpose, until fellowship applications open.
business.detail: Correctly empty. The system will not invent work for a domain you have deliberately left alone.

momentum.label: returned to you this quarter — study planning, credential admin, loan paperwork, and correspondence you no longer draft from nothing.
momentum.note: Estimated from your own logged times. No clinical work appears in this number, because none of it happens here.
momentum.caption: the study habit finally held from week 7

risks.what: The question that is your actual job
risks.guard: Differential, dosing, workup — for an identified patient. Refused here at every tier, including Green. Not because it is outside your training; it is the whole of your training. Because this system has no clearance, no validation, and no institutional governance behind it. The boundary is about the tool, not about you.

risks.what: A chart detail carried across at 4 a.m.
risks.guard: Import refuses on PHI indicators and a nightly lint sweeps everything already stored. Post-call is exactly when it would happen. The system catches it.

risks.what: Reaching for an ungoverned window at 4 a.m.
risks.guard: No governed system can reach a chat window it does not run, and your program’s own AI policy governs there, not this. This one is yours to keep — it is the reason the rails are worth having.

license.scopeNote: You are operating inside nursing-authored doctrine, on purpose. EDENA was written by nurses and anchored in nursing ethics, and it governs you here exactly as it governs them. Nothing about it needed to be medicine-specific, because the rails describe the tool’s limits rather than the profession’s. Agents propose. Humans judge. Nurses steward — including the ones who wrote the rules you are working under.

opps.body: It covers the ITE question bank you are already paying for yourself.
